title: Spiral Stitch round a hole: ring40-hole15-pitch3p0, round 7
description: PE-DESIGN 11.50's Spiral Stitch round a hole, round 7: a spiral from the outline inwards and one round the hole. PE: Run pitch 3,0. PE sews the outline's spiral inwards to the middle of the band, then the band where the two spirals meet as separate trimmed pieces (each with a tie-in and a lock), then the hole's spiral: 31 pieces every 11.25°; 64 trims. OpenStitch joins its two spirals with one travel and does not sew the band pieces. Open, pinned at the internal tier: stitches (PE 1632, OpenStitch 1141); stitch-length-mean (PE 1.7726, OpenStitch 1.9374).

references.make: round 4's 40 mm ring with a 15 mm hole; region Spiral Stitch on the outer shape. Hoop 100 x 100 mm page; line Not Sewn (Line); colour 800 EMBROIDERY RED; region attributes at their defaults (Density 2,0 line/mm, Run pitch 2,0 mm, Start Point first button) unless stated; nothing else in the design. Save As PES (default type, #PES0110). Status bar 39,30 x 39,70 mm, 1632 st.
